DIAGNOSIS READY: Gout

The clinical picture of a 69-year-old male with progressive pain in the left great toe, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest is highly characteristic of gout. The recent onset of pain in the great toe (podagra) combined with the positive Uric Acid test result supports this diagnosis over other arthritides or cellulitis.
